questions.question: Relate data visualization techniques to real-world decision-making processes.
questions.solution_html:
• Relate data visualization techniques to real-world decision-making processes.
  • Ans: Data visualization techniques play a key role in real-world decision-making by
  • transforming complex data into clear, understandable visuals.
  •  Better understanding of data: Charts and graphs (bar charts, line graphs) help decision
  • makers quickly grasp trends and patterns.
  •  Identifying relationships and trends: Visuals like scatter plots and heatmaps reveal
  • correlations and hidden insights.
  •  Faster decision-making: Visual representation reduces time needed to analyze large
  • datasets.
  •  Improved communication: Visuals make it easier to present findings to stakeholders and
  • support arguments.
  •  Risk reduction: By clearly showing patterns and anomalies, visualization helps in making
  • informed and accurate decisions.
  • Thus, data visualization helps organizations and individuals make smarter, evidence-based
  • decisions in areas like business, healthcare, education, and government.
questions.final_answer: decisions in areas like business, healthcare, education, and government

questions.question: What is a multi-plot grid in Seaborn? How is it useful?
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: A multi-plot grid in Seaborn refers to a structured way of displaying multiple plots in a
  • grid layout, where each subplot represents a subset of the data. Seaborn provides built-in classes
  • like FacetGrid, PairGrid, and JointGrid to create such visualizations.
  • Uses
  •  It helps in comparing patterns across different subsets of data easily.
  •  Makes it simple to visualize relationships between variables under different conditions.
  •  Improves clarity and organization instead of crowding all data into one plot.
  •  Useful for detecting trends, variations, and outliers across categories.
  •  Widely used in exploratory data analysis (EDA) for deeper insights.
  • Definition- (3 Marks) , Uses- (2 Marks)

questions.question: Describe the role of storytelling in data visualization and how it improves / comprehension.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: Storytelling in data visualization refers to presenting data with a clear narrative so that it
  • conveys meaningful insights instead of just raw numbers or charts.
  • How it improves comprehension
  •  Makes complex data simple and easy to understand.
  •  Helps in quick identification of trends and patterns.
  •  Improves memory and engagement compared to plain data.
  •  Supports better decision-making by clearly conveying insights.
  • Definition (2 Marks) , Any three improvisations- (3 Marks)

questions.solution_html:
• appropriate diagrams.
  • Ans: Different charts are used based on the type of data and purpose
  •  Comparison → Bar chart
  •  Trend → Line chart
  •  Proportion → Pie chart
  •  Distribution → Histogram/Box plot
  •  Relationship → Scatter plot
  • (1Mark) for each Chart with diagram and Explanations
questions.final_answer: for each Chart with diagram and Explanations

questions.question: Compare the effectiveness of line plots and scatter plots in data representation.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: Line plots and scatter plots are both used to show relationships between variables
  •  Trend analysis: Line plot is more effective.
  •  Relationship/correlation: Scatter plot is more effective.
  •  Data continuity: Line plot emphasizes continuity; scatter plot does not.
  •  Outlier detection: Scatter plot is better.
  • Line plots – (2.5 marks) Scatter plots- (2.5marks)

questions.question: Differentiate Plotly Express and Plotly Grpah Objects.
questions.solution_html:
• Ans: Plotly Express
  •  A high-level interface for creating plots quickly.
  •  Requires less code and is easy to use.
  •  Built on top of Graph Objects.
  •  Automatically handles data mapping, labels, and styling.
  •  Suitable for quick visualization and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Plotly Graph Objects
  •  A low-level, detailed interface.
  •  Requires more code and manual control.
  •  Allows full customization of every element (layout, axes, annotations).
  •  Suitable for complex and highly customized visualizations.
  • Plotly Express -(2.5 Marks) Plotly Graph Objects -(2.5 Marks)
